quarterly_data.signal: Data center design and power efficiency: Sweetwater 1 is becoming the reference design for Sweetwater 2, Kiowa, Bundey and later projects, with common layouts and equipment plus more modularisation and prefab, explicitly built for successive GPU generations and evolving cooling INCLUDING 800-VOLT DC, all developed in collaboration with NVIDIA - a direct answer to the bear case that AI data centers get rebuilt in ten years. IREN also expects to extract more from sites it already owns: existing sites have SPARE POWER BEYOND CURRENT DEPLOYMENT PLANS that can support more GPUs and revenue WITHOUT NEW GRID CAPACITY, the scarcest input in the industry, starting with new liquid-cooled installs at Mackenzie, Canal Flats and Prince George in 2027. Tools such as NVIDIA MaxLPS, which smooths GPU power draw, and the NVIDIA DSX reference architecture, which runs chips at higher temperatures without giving up performance, let IREN direct more of each megawatt to IT load. Headline PUE has been deliberately conservative at 200 megawatts of IT load for 300 megawatts of gross capacity, and IREN uses a highly efficient CLOSED-LOOP liquid cooling system with minimal ongoing water usage.

quarterly_data.signal: Software layer: MIRANTIS was named an INAUGURAL NVIDIA-CERTIFIED HYPERVISOR on the day of the call, which co-CEO Daniel Roberts said makes IREN 'the only neocloud certified hypervisor from NVIDIA,' giving NVIDIA validation at the software layer as well as the hardware layer. Commercially, Mirantis opens new customer classes: very large hyperscaler and frontier-lab customers take compute bare metal, but smaller AI developers, labs and enterprises value an orchestration layer on top, and Mirantis also enables ON-DEMAND compute alongside reserved managed clusters plus enterprise support, monitoring and deployment capability. IREN's rationale for owning all three layers - data centers, compute and software - is that each layer makes the one underneath worth more. Headcount nearly TRIPLED in FY2026 including hundreds of colleagues joining through Mirantis and Nostrum, with similar growth expected in FY2027 and five C-suite appointments hired from NVIDIA, AWS, Oracle, Google and other leading data center operators.

quarterly_data.signal: On Texas regulation, management addressed Governor Abbott's directive - which targets transparency, grid reliability, water usage and impact on local communities - by noting IREN funded all required grid upgrades at Childress, sited it a number of miles outside the main town with no residential neighbours, and uses a highly efficient closed-loop water-cooling system with very minimal ongoing water usage. IREN said it welcomes the additional transparency and is positioned well with two very large already-energised Texas sites, and expects a tighter interconnection process to favour real and well-capitalised projects. Co-CEO Daniel Roberts framed the macro backdrop with the observation that across eight models tracked by OpenRouter, weekly token usage across large language models increased NEARLY 17x IN 8 MONTHS, which is very difficult to serve with infrastructure on three-year lead times.
